newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BOK offers to buy dlrs in forward trading - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BOK offers to buy dlrs in forward trading - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Korea intervened in the interbank market in late Thursday morning, offering to buy dollars in one- and three-month forward trading, dealers said.
Officials at the central bank were not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said the central bank offered to buy $20 million in one-month forward trading at 892.50 won per dollar and another $20 million in three-month forward trading at 897.50 won.
In spot trading, the South Korean won fell to 891.20 by 0214 GMT soon after the intervention from 890.10-890.20.
The central bank's intervention was seen aimed at preventing the local currency's sharp rise against the dollar in the wake of the firming of the Japanese yen in overseas markets.
